basic_profile.bio: Recently got into gaming during the pandemic and discovered Destiny 2 through friends. I enjoy exploring new games, especially those with rich lore and community engagement. Currently living in a small town in the Midwest, working as a junior graphic designer. My online hours are mostly in the evenings after work and on weekends. Not in a relationship, which gives me more time to dive into gaming and online communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of gaming, largely self-taught through YouTube tutorials and community forums since joining a few months ago. I'm still learning the ropes of Destiny 2 but have a growing interest in expanding my knowledge.
